spec_name: R5 post-hoc hyper-parameter sensitivity + cost-component ablation

holdout_protection.enforcement: runner asserts requested seeds are a subset of allowed_data_seeds; any intersection with holdout_seeds_FORBIDDEN raises SystemExit before any data access
holdout_protection.policy: 301-305 were executed exactly once (frozen confirmatory holdout). This experiment NEVER re-runs them. Only pre-existing frozen CSV/JSON artifacts may be READ to place independent markers on figures.

data_source.reproduction_check: marginals recomputed from flows.json equal the frozen transport_uot.npz marginals to 0.0 absolute error (see 00_preflight/reproduction_check.json)

provenance.k: D4 mutual-rank decoder k=5, frozen in the preregistration (scripts/multi_bridge/decoder_audit/da_common.py DECODE_K=5, holdout_common.K5=5)
provenance.epsilon: UOT entropic regularisation reg=0.05 (baseline_mechanism/common.py FROZEN_PARAMS['uot_reg']; holdout identity_check reg==0.05)
provenance.lambda: UOT marginal relaxation reg_m=0.5 (FROZEN_PARAMS['uot_reg_m']; holdout identity_check reg_m==0.5)
provenance.note: All three were fixed BEFORE this post-hoc grid and are NOT modified by it.

methods.name: RAW_UOT_PLAN_D4
methods.decoder: mutual top-k on the UOT transport plan P (row-rank <= k AND col-rank <= k)

methods.name: CONDITIONAL_UOT_D4
methods.decoder: mutual top-k on the dual-cancelled conditional scores S_row = P_ij / c_j, S_col = P_ij / r_i

solver.uot: ot.unbalanced.sinkhorn_unbalanced(a, b, C, reg=epsilon, reg_m=lambda, numItermax=20000, stopThr=1e-11, log=True)
solver.convergence_criterion: final POT error < 1e-7 (diag.ctd_common.solve_uot_log convention, reused unchanged)
solver.note: numItermax/stopThr are NOT tuned. The iteration-count instrumentation does not change the update, the stopping rule or the numerics; it only attaches POT's own log['err'] trace which the solver already computes internally.

decoder_score_construction.a_rw: risk-lifted source marginal: a0 * (1 + lambda_risk * aml_risk_score_raw / 100), normalised (uot_solver._risk_weighted_source_mass)
decoder_score_construction.b_ev: evidence-weighted target marginal: b0 * evidence_quality_score, normalised (uot_solver._evidence_weighted_target_mass)
decoder_score_construction.note: lambda in this experiment is the UOT MARGINAL RELAXATION reg_m, not lambda_risk. lambda_risk stays at its frozen value 0.25.

unique_configurations.rationale: (k=5, eps=0.05, lambda=0.5) appears in all three sweeps and is computed EXACTLY ONCE; the shared row is referenced by the other two sweeps in the summary.
unique_configurations.total_tasks: 3 bridges x 5 seeds x 14 configurations = 210 cells; 2 methods per cell; 1 UOT solve per cell (the plan is shared by both decoders)

metrics.edge_precision: tp / (tp + fp) over predicted vs ground-truth (split u merge u decoy) edges of the cell
metrics.macro_edge_f1: unweighted mean over the 48 templates of the per-template edge F1 = 2*P*R/(P+R)
metrics.aggregation_to_seed: mean over the 48 templates of that (bridge, seed, configuration, method) cell
metrics.aggregation_to_bridge: mean over the 5 development seeds; std = sample std (ddof=1) over the 5 seed values

unmatched_mass_definition.source_mass_reference: a_rw (risk-weighted source marginal actually passed to the solver)
unmatched_mass_definition.target_mass_reference: b_ev (evidence-weighted target marginal actually passed to the solver)
unmatched_mass_definition.delta_s_total: sum_i |sum_j P_ij - a_rw_i|  (L1 marginal violation of the SOURCE marginal)
unmatched_mass_definition.delta_t_total: sum_j |sum_i P_ij - b_ev_j|  (L1 marginal violation of the TARGET marginal)
unmatched_mass_definition.delta_total: delta_s_total + delta_t_total (derived; delta_S and delta_T are always reported separately)
unmatched_mass_definition.note: These are the genuine RC-UOT unbalanced-OT marginal deviations produced by the solver under reg_m=lambda, read directly from the returned plan. No surrogate 'unmatched count' is invented.

cost_component_ablation.condition: leave-one-cost-component-out on CONDITIONAL_UOT_D4 only, k=5, epsilon=0.05, lambda=0.5 (defaults never re-tuned)
cost_component_ablation.renormalisation: after setting the omitted component's weight to 0, the remaining weights are rescaled so they sum to 1 (scale-preserving, so that epsilon keeps its meaning)
cost_component_ablation.existing_amount_free_artifact_check: out/multi_bridge_expansion/amount_free_candidate_dev holds an AMOUNT_FREE_COST_D4 arm. It is compared against LOO_AMOUNT; if it differs in scale or spec, the freshly computed LOO_AMOUNT is used and the discrepancy is recorded.
cost_component_ablation.scope: 3 bridges x 5 dev seeds x 7 cost variants = 105 cells, CONDITIONAL_UOT_D4 only (plus the frozen RAW_UOT_PLAN_D4 reference row)

figure_spec.layout: 1 figure with 3 bridge panels (Celer / Multichain / PolyNetwork), shared y-axis (Macro edge F1)
figure_spec.default_marker: vertical dashed line at the paper default value
figure_spec.holdout_marker: independent marker at the default x position, copied read-only from pre-existing frozen holdout results; NOT connected to the dev curves
figure_spec.caption_disclaimer: Development sensitivity uses seeds 201-205 only. Frozen holdout markers at the default setting are copied from pre-existing results; seeds 301-305 were not re-run.

interpretation_rules: The defaults were fixed before this grid; the grid is NOT used for hyper-parameter selection.
Whether the default is also the grid optimum is decided by the data, never assumed.
No main-experiment default may be changed as a result of this experiment.
No holdout result may be recomputed, re-derived or optimised against.
